Q2 FY27 Performance Highlights


  ➢  Revenue:
           - INR Revenue of ₹ 731,880 Mn, up 1.3% QoQ | up 11.2% YoY
           - USD Revenue of $ 7,642 Mn, up 0.2% QoQ | up 2.4% YoY
           - Constant currency revenue up 0.5% QoQ | up 2.8% YoY

  ➢  Profit:
           - Operating Margin at 24.0%
           - Net Margin at 19.0%
           - Cash flow from operations at 102.2% of net profit

  ➢  Demand:

           -  Clients $10M+ up by 2 ; $5M+ up by 6 & $1M+ up by 11 QoQ

           -  Order book TCV at $9.6 Bn

  ➢  People:
           - Closing headcount: 598,056
           - Voluntary LTM attrition at 13.3% in IT Services
